findings.issue_summary: The mobile app targets API 35 and cannot meet the API 36 submission requirement
findings.evidence: The default configuration sets targetSdk to 35 and compileSdk to 35. The checked-in debug APK also reports target API 35. Google Play requires API 36 or later for new mobile apps and updates starting August 31, 2026. The announced extension ended November 1, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to at least 36, test the Android 16 behavior changes, and confirm the target SDK in the release artifact before submission. [Google Play target API level requirements](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/11926878)

findings.issue_summary: Verify the Play Console declaration for the dataSync foreground service
findings.evidence: AgentRunService declares dataSync with the required permission. Starting a user-requested agent run starts the service, which preserves the active network response stream while the app is backgrounded. The ongoing notification shows progress and includes Stop. Run completion stops the service. This fits the stated server-side processing example. Play Console declaration status remains unverified.
findings.recommendation: Declare dataSync under App content, describe how deferring or interrupting the stream affects the user, and attach a video showing the user starting a run, backgrounding the app, and stopping it from the ongoing notification. [Google Play foreground service requirements](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/13392821)
